summary: Bruker Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a reorganization of its reportable segments, effective July 1, 2026, into BSI BIOS, BSI Microbiology and Infection Diagnostics (BMID), BSI NANO, and BEST. The filing provides recast historical segment information in Exhibit 99.1 for comparability. No transaction terms, securities, consideration, or board recommendations are involved; the realignment did not affect historical consolidated results, financial position, or cash flows. This is an accounting/segment reporting event, not a special situation; watch for restated segment disclosures and margin comparisons under the new structure.
